powerTrio.label: Content Architecture
powerTrio.heading: Three layers, infinite flexibility
powerTrio.subheading: PageTemplate, PageSlot, and CmsComponent — the three layers powering Craftive's content engine. Each managed independently, together they form a complete content infrastructure.

items.name: PageTemplate
items.label: Template Layer
items.description: Defines the skeleton of your page — which slots exist and where. Define once, propagate across every page that uses the template.

items.name: PageSlot
items.label: Region Layer
items.description: Named content regions within the page. Each slot is driven by the template and hosts independent, reorderable components.

items.name: CmsComponent
items.label: Content Layer
items.description: The actual content units inside slots. Banners, carousels, rich text, product grids — each type independently configured and managed.

cards.title: Modular Architecture
cards.description: Page builder, media management, component library and more. Enable or disable each module as needed.

cards.title: DB Isolation
cards.description: Separate database per tenant. Zero data leakage risk; full GDPR compliance and independent backups.

cards.title: Headless REST API
cards.description: JSON-based REST APIs let you choose your frontend freely. Next.js, Angular, React Native — all compatible.

cards.title: Multi-Tenant
cards.description: One deployment, hundreds of customers. Each tenant gets their own subdomain, settings, and customizations.

faq.heading: What you should know before deciding
faq.subheading: Short answers to the questions that matter most when evaluating fit, delivery model, technical flexibility, and rollout process.

items.question: Who is Craftive a strong fit for?
items.answer: Craftive is strongest today for teams that need a corporate web platform, publishing hub, headless catalog/storefront foundation, or a reusable delivery base for multiple client projects. It works best when you want to avoid rebuilding common capabilities from scratch each time.

items.question: Is Craftive the right choice for every project?
items.answer: No. Craftive is not positioned as a one-size-fits-all product. It is the right fit when your project can benefit from a shared platform foundation, modular capability selection, tenant-safe isolation, and controlled customization instead of a fully bespoke rebuild.

items.question: What am I actually buying with Craftive?
items.answer: You are not buying a fixed package product. You are buying the right solution foundation for your use case, typically including the platform base, the right module set, setup and configuration, any required adaptation or integration work, and ongoing operational support where needed.

items.question: Is Craftive a self-serve SaaS product?
items.answer: No. Craftive's main model is project-based delivery, not self-serve SaaS. The goal is not to fit every customer into the same package, but to shape a modular solution around the actual needs of the project.

items.question: Can I keep my existing frontend or integrations?
items.answer: Yes. Craftive is built as a headless-ready foundation, so you can keep an existing frontend or build a new presentation layer based on the needs of the project. Next.js, Angular, and other frontend approaches can all fit into that model.

items.question: What does tenant isolation give me in practice?
items.answer: Database-per-tenant isolation creates clearer operational boundaries between projects or customers. It reduces cross-tenant risk and makes maintenance, backup, recovery, and long-term expansion easier to manage with confidence.

items.question: How is pricing determined?
items.answer: Pricing is project-based rather than package-based. The main drivers are the module set involved, tenant and content complexity, frontend adaptation needs, integration scope, and the level of operational support required after launch.

items.question: What does the delivery process look like?
items.answer: The usual flow starts with a discovery call, then moves into needs and scope clarification, a recommended solution and module set, and a demo or proposal where useful. After alignment, setup, implementation, and go-live are handled in a structured rollout.

items.question: Can the solution expand after launch?
items.answer: Yes. Craftive is designed to support maintenance, operational continuity, and future expansion after the initial delivery. New modules, new tenant rollouts, and deeper adaptations can be added on top of the same reusable foundation.
